name: io.github.tosinchukwu/mintbeacon
title: MintBeacon
description: Read-only BNB Chain mint verification, deployment status, and live free-mint feed.

tools.name: mintbeacon_status
tools.description: Inspect the live MintBeacon deployment on BNB Smart Chain: chain ID, contract address, Agent ID registry, distinct Agent ID holder count and total successful on-chain checks. This is read-only and does not increment either counter. No wallet address is required.

tools.name: verify_mint
tools.description: Verify whether a BSC contract looks like a FREE, gas-only Agent ID mint for the supplied checker address. Always supply the actual user's or agent's wallet; omission uses a legacy deployer-wallet default and is not personalised to the MCP caller. Returns verdict (UNKNOWN/FREE/LIKELY_FREE/PAID), method, minted/maxSupply, and whether the checker holds an Agent ID. LIKELY_FREE means 'probably free — deep-check recommended', never a guarantee. Read-only: never signs or sends transactions. When the MintBeacon contract is not deployed, runs an off-chain probe against the target and says so.

contractAddress.description: BSC contract address to verify (0x, 40 hex characters).

checkerAddress.description: Address the verdict is personalised for. Always pass the actual user's or agent's wallet for a personalised result. Optional only for backward compatibility; omission uses the deployer-wallet default and does not identify the caller.

tools.name: free_mints_feed
tools.description: List currently free, live Agent ID mints from the MINTS feed (mints-bnb.pages.dev). Returns name, contract address and minted/supply when present. This is a curated feed, not a MintBeacon verification — run verify_mint on a contract before acting on it.
